text: The old dev build (sufr-dev at c69cc0a on catalyst; tmp-claude/2026-10-27-search-api-bench/sufr-old here) misorders suffixes starting at the last N of a run before the sequence delimiter under --dna -a: descending position with LCP 1, not the text after the delimiter. A byte comparison against it is NO on any input with a run of N ending a record, hg38 among them. The oracle case n_ends pins the right order. Found 2026-11-05.
